audience: sellers of software and digital products who run a store on Lemon Squeezy

useCases.title: Find all orders from one buyer
useCases.text: The AI lists orders filtered by store and buyer email, finds the customer, and opens an order to read its details.

useCases.title: Review active and cancelled subscriptions
useCases.text: The AI lists subscriptions filtered by store, status, product, variant, customer or buyer email, and opens one to read it.

useCases.title: Check subscription invoices by status or refund
useCases.text: The AI lists subscription invoices filtered by store, status or refunded flag, so you see which invoices were refunded or have a problem.

useCases.title: Find the license keys of an order or product
useCases.text: The AI lists license keys filtered by store, order or product, so you can check which keys were issued for a customer's order.

useCases.title: Create a payment link for a product variant
useCases.text: The AI looks up the store, product and variant and creates a hosted checkout. You get the shareable payment link.

useCases.title: Change, pause or cancel a subscription
useCases.text: The AI changes the plan (variant), pauses or unpauses, sets the billing anchor, or cancels a live subscription at the end of the billing period.
